start_here: Say to your AI: "Which lessons of first-principles have I done?" It runs tool:read-a-learners-done-lessons for the signed-in learner.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it reads the done table of the pursuit database for one learner and changes nothing.
instructions: 1. Name the pursuit database that holds the rows, such as example_for_who_uses_it; the computer opens it with the read login its vault holds.
2. Say what you want in plain words; your AI calls tools:run with tool tool:read-a-learners-done-lessons and the input.
3. Read the answer: the ids of the lessons done, oldest first. Show it with the screen the tool names.
